svg.title: evict-snapkv
svg.desc: SnapKV on a toy 40-token prompt: the last 8 prompt queries (the observation window) vote with their attention, votes are max-pooled so neighbours of a hit survive, and each head keeps its own top 8 positions plus the window. Real setting: window 32, pool kernel 7, budget 1024 of a 16K prompt (6.25%).

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif
STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: prefix keys j (toy 40 of a 16K prompt)
once, at the end of prefill · decode tokens are appended and never pruned
Real: window 32 · max-pool kernel 7 · budget 1024 / 2048 / 4096 · 16K prompt at budget 1024 keeps 6.25% + 32
reported at 16K: 3.6× generation speed, 8.2× memory efficiency · up to 380K tokens on one A100-80GB
